answer: Randomised submission windows at the tundra layer: each identity gets a unique 30s slot, so one operator cannot batch-mine. A jade ledger logs timing entropy across slots; correlated wallets cluster and get slashed. Sybils must rent distinct slots, costing roughly $4 each plus 20 CPU-hours per identity, so a 100-wallet farm burns $400+ before any comet reward. The mechanism works because temporal entropy makes parallel identity farming linearly costly, not free.
